references.text: Both verses describe the same event (Pharaoh's dream by the Nile) and belong to the same narrative sequence.
The verses form the beginning and end points of the same dialogue about Pharaoh's dream by the Nile.
Clear theological contrast: Pharaoh as recipient of God's message by the Nile (Gen) vs. Pharaoh as a self-sufficient god who owns the Nile (Ezek).
